subject: Clarify accelerator promo credits / tiering + commitment ask
messages:
From: Ava Gomez <ava@launchbridge.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: LaunchBridge Partnerships <partners@launchbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood accelerator promo — credits + tiering question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — LaunchBridge loved the throughput and the cost breakdown. We're putting together our accelerator benefits package and want to include Redwood as the preferred inference partner. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we finalize the program materials:

- The promo credits you mentioned — are they tied to usage tiers (e.g., $X of credits valid up to Y tokens/month), or can we front-load a fixed credit pool per cohort?
- If a startup exceeds the cohort allocation, what's the overage pricing and are there flexible commit options (monthly vs. quarterly)?
- We sometimes need short-term "burst" top-ups for demo days; can those be pre-approved by contract rather than case-by-case?

Attached is a one-page summary of our typical cohort sizes and expected token patterns for Q3/Q4. Would appreciate a short email confirming whether we can: 1) get a per-cohort fixed credit pool, 2) set a usage ceiling per team that won't automatically trigger a billing charge (we prefer a notification + 72h grace), and 3) pre-approve up to two burst top-ups per cohort at a discounted unit rate.

If it helps, loop in your sales ops / pricing manager. We hope to lock this in before our cohort kickoff on Sept 7.

Best,
Ava
Ava Gomez
Head of Accelerator Programs
LaunchBridge

Attachment: LaunchBridge_Program_Summary.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ava Gomez <ava@launchbridge.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood accelerator promo — credits + tiering question

Hi Ava — really appreciate the clear ask and the cohort details. Quick answers below and I flagged a couple of items for internal review. Looping in Lauren (pricing) to confirm the exception path for cohort-level pools.

1) Credit model: We can do either. Standard is tiered credits tied to monthly usage tiers (e.g., Starter cohort: 50k token credits/month). But we can provision a fixed per-cohort credit pool that is consumed by teams in that cohort. That approach is common for incubators.

2) Overage handling: By default overage triggers billing at standard pay-as-you-go. For accelerator partners we can set a usage ceiling + notification flow: once a team hits 90% of their allocation, they get an automated alert; at 100% we can pause automatic billing and hold for 72h while you approve top-up. That behavior requires a signed addendum (commitment to the cohort-level pool) and a short SLO in the contract.

3) Burst top-ups: We can pre-authorize up to two burst top-ups per cohort at a 15% unit discount off listed pay-as-you-go rates. Bursts are subject to capacity constraints; for guaranteed bursts we recommend a nominal reserved-capacity add-on.

I'll get Lauren's formal confirmation on the discounted burst rate and the contract language. If acceptable, I can draft the addendum and a simple DocuSign link for cohort-level pool allocation.

Quick ask: can you confirm typical per-team token ceilings you expect during demo day vs. normal weeks? The attached usage sheet helps but having an upper bound will let us propose guardrails that minimize surprise billing.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Forwarding — Sofia, looks like LaunchBridge is asking for a per-cohort pool + overage guardrails and two pre-approved bursts. I support the cohort-pool approach for partner retention, but we should limit admin burden. Ben, can you propose a commercial that balances economics and risk?

Suggested constraints:
- Per-cohort pooled credit with per-team sub-allocations (configurable)
- 72h non-billed grace on exceed; auto-bill if no approval after 72h
- Two bursts pre-approved per cohort at 15% discount; guaranteed bursts require reserved capacity add-on priced separately
- Apply to up to 3 cohorts per year under one addendum; further cohorts require renewal

Also attach the public accelerator tiers doc to the reply (redwood_accelerator_tiers.pdf).

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Revenue Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_accelerator_tiers.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Gomez <ava@launchbridge.io>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood accelerator promo — credits + tiering question

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear framing and Sofia/Lauren for the internal notes. Based on LaunchBridge's cohort sizes and the sample usage, here's a compact commercial proposal that should be easy to sign and operationalize before Sept 7: 

Proposal (summary):
- Per-cohort credit pool: one-time grant of 750k token credits per cohort (applies to the entire cohort, not per company). Unused credits do not rollover between cohorts.
- Per-team soft ceiling: admins can set per-team caps inside the pool; defaults to 100k tokens/month unless otherwise requested.
- Overage flow: 1) 90% automated alert, 2) at 100% we pause charges and notify LaunchBridge + team, 3) 72-hour approval window where LaunchBridge can allow auto-billing or request a paid top-up. If no response we bill standard overage rate.
- Burst top-ups: up to two pre-approved bursts per cohort at 15% discount; bursts > pre-approved will be billed at standard overage with an opt-in guaranteed-reservation SKU at an additional cost.
- Term: applies to up to 3 cohorts in a 12-month period; early renewals possible with revised economics.
- Pricing: base grant covered at no charge for eligible accelerator partners (LaunchBridge qualifies per partner program), additional credits purchased at $0.000012/token (post-discount $0.0000102/token for bursts).

Attachments included: redwood_accelerator_tiers.pdf (public tiers) and usage_samples_Q2.xlsx (your supplied file with our annotations).

Next steps: I can draft an addendum (2 pages) and a DocuSign envelope for signature. If you'd like a small pilot guarantee for the demo day (to ensure reserved capacity), we can add a one-week reserved SKU for $1,200 per cohort demo day.

If this looks good, Sofia and I will prepare the addendum and a DocuSign link today.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0220

Attachments: redwood_accelerator_tiers.pdf, usage_samples_Q2.xlsx

From: Ava Gomez <ava@launchbridge.io>

Subject: Re: Redwood accelerator promo — credits + tiering question

Ben / Sofia — thanks, this is exactly the pragmatic structure we needed. A few quick items before we sign: 

1) Can the per-cohort pool be split into per-track allocations (e.g., Founder track gets 60% of pool, Research track 25%, Demo teams 15%)? We can supply the split at setup and expect it to be final per cohort.
2) On pricing: the burst discount number is acceptable. For the reserved SKU, can you confirm whether it covers both throughput and guaranteed latency (we typically need a 95th p99 latency guarantee for demo day flows)?
3) Please include a clause that unused pool credits are visible in the portal for both LaunchBridge admins and individual teams (so we can reallocate mid-cohort if needed).

If you can update the addendum with the per-track allocation option and the visibility clause, we can route to procurement and have the signature back by EOD Friday. We also want the DocuSign envelope to reference HubSpot Deal ID DEAL-3982 in the signature metadata.

Appreciate the speed on this — aiming to be green across the board by Friday.

Thanks,
Ava
